title: The Best Vitamins for Hair Growth (and Which Ones Actually Matter)
seo_title: Best Vitamins for Hair Growth: What Works | FullyVital
seo_description: Which vitamins help hair grow? Iron, vitamin D, zinc, B12 and biotin: what each does, signs you're low, whether hair supplements work, and how to choose one.
summary_html: Which vitamins and minerals matter for hair growth, how to tell if you're low, whether hair supplements work, and how to choose one.
notes: Rebuilds the 2023 'Top 5 Hair Growth Vitamins' page in place as the hub for the vitamins cluster: 'vitamins for hair growth' (27,100/month, KD 14) and 'best vitamins for hair growth' (14,800, KD 12). The page currently ranks around 65-85 for 'essential vitamins for hair growth' and 'which vitamin is good for hair growth'.

Removes old claims such as vitamins 'scientifically proven to... prevent hair loss' and 'proven effective in stimulating hair growth', plus old product links (/enhance-hair-growth-serum, /enhance-hair-serum-3-pack, a tracking-tagged collection link).

FAQ built from Google's 'People also ask' for 'vitamins for hair growth' and 'skin hair nail vitamins': what vitamin you're lacking, biotin vs B12, the 'big 3', growth and thickness, whether hair/skin/nail vitamins work.

3 studies, each linked once in the references: a 2019 review of vitamins and minerals in hair loss, a 2017 biotin review (all 18 benefit cases had an underlying cause) and a 2017 diet and hair loss review (correct deficiencies; some supplements can worsen hair loss).
Honest product bridge: Hair Revival Supplements ingredients come from the product sheet, and the page says they don't contain iron.
After you approve: /blogs/hair-care/hair-loss-vitamins (in the rewrite queue, 2 impressions in 16 months) redirects here.
